initialFindingDisposition.basis: Active artifacts now contain only beat-local public records; private analysis remains sealed.
TruthLedger is fact-only; propagation and analytic ledgers are separate typed records.
The ending follows selected decisions and typed effects without exposing the deliberate-misrepresentation ledger.
SceneDisclosure separates records, questions, and unknowns at each beat.
Generated-pack, completed-path, direct-builder, persistence, and route counterexamples now supplement source contracts.
Artifact copy is short, form-bounded, and no longer contains a private analytic essay.
Disclosure is beat-local and the repeated seven-surface conclusion was removed.
Playable choices retain concrete action and omission while analytic motive returns to subtext.
The seven-tab debrief is replaced by one normal-flow naturalized summary and a separate concept receipt.
Accepted-scene concepts are deduplicated and rendered after the summary with typed status and evidence.
The prescriptive Heart was removed; the ending is state-derived and contains no moral grade.
Factual resolution, unresolved motive, and bounded model claims remain distinct.
Internal validation is no longer presented as empirical causal coherence in the conclusion.
Modeled values are labelled as model output and the adjacent model limit remains visible.
Typed content, format, and ambient semantics plus selected-carriage receipts govern all route wording.
Universal and false-fact slogans were removed or narrowed to the modeled night.
Blocked choices remain operable explanations with one global announcement path; manual screen-reader review remains pending.
Relationship detail no longer places the entire selected-node panel inside a live region; manual screen-reader review remains pending.
Reach is exposed as modeled impressions and no logarithmic percentage is presented under the same name.
Completed-room, reason-toggle, replay, and focus copy were corrected; final assistive-technology phrasing review remains pending.
Privacy names the browser-profile boundary, export says text was handed to the browser, and integrity copy does not imply authorship or authentication.
The fixed lineage is labelled Meme reference and general reference rather than played-path evidence.
Player copy leads with concrete incidents; technical vocabulary is confined to documentation and labelled model surfaces.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Direct-link availability was narrated as selected carriage.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Event kind, semantic, selectedCarriage, selectedCarriageReach, applied reach, background reach, and avoided reach now select separate clauses.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Generic content was promoted to a factual record.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Typed content is now called message content; record language is reserved for factual scenario records.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Encountered concept limits could assert an unrealized authored outcome.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Every limit is a conditional evidence boundary and distinguishes selected action from modeled effect.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Played evidence promised downstream effects were listed when the card rendered none.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Played copy now says it records only the selected action and claims no later outcome.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Ambient summary copy denied content but could imply recognizable-form carriage.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Ambient prose denies both message content and recognizable form; format reuse was narrowed to imitation pressure.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Market and status limits treated selected intent as if an ambient receipt proved it.
postRewriteFindings.correction: The limits state action-or-effect alternatives and explicitly deny motive inference from modeled effects.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Earlier last-resort selections and long costs could be omitted or truncated.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Every selected last resort retains complete protected party, benefit, harmed party, harm, and self-cost copy.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Background impressions were described as unique people reached.
postRewriteFindings.correction: The concept evidence now says modeled impressions.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Repeated labels were used as cross-room event identity.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Each decision keeps its own identifier and is narrated independently.

postRewriteFindings.finding: The exact-rule provenance test ignored event kind and skipped decision-only rules.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Test events are tagged as choice or ambient and a decision-only selected-carriage match is required.

postRewriteFindings.finding: Full last-resort clauses could end with doubled punctuation or a stiff cost transition.
postRewriteFindings.correction: Sentence joining owns punctuation and the transition now says benefits and costs landed in different places.

postRewriteFindings.finding: A late naturalization pass could call an absent sentence-packing helper and fail the completed summary at runtime.
postRewriteFindings.correction: The complete-sentence paragraph packer is implemented, type-checked, and exercised by all completed-summary contract paths.

postRewriteFindings.finding: An opening could repeat an inquiry already carried by its artifact and push an otherwise complete paragraph beyond the atomized bound.
postRewriteFindings.correction: The opening detects inquiry already present in the artifact, retains the open question without repeating its full clause, and packs only at complete-sentence boundaries.

finalDisposition.independentReadOnlyRecheck: No blocker or high-severity semantic copy issue remained after the final corrections.
manualLimitations: The cloud browser blocked the local preview, so a current-source interactive browser completion was not recorded.
VoiceOver and NVDA reading-order and announcement review were not performed.
Static viewport contracts do not replace manual 320px, short-landscape, 200% zoom, forced-colors, or reduced-motion inspection.
